commits.subject: roadmap(ajc): record the import-campaign ordering rule that wave 2 disproved
commits.summary:
Bottom-up conversion is correct for probe accuracy but net-negative whenever a module has a cone of import-less dependents: narrowing `Presheaf.lean` stripped the library from nine modules up the `StructureSheafModuleK → Genus → Jacobian` chain, and wave 2 as a whole converted 8 modules while forcing 25 back onto the umbrella (39 → 64 bare). The rule is now: give the import-less dependents their own precise imports first, top-down within the cone, then narrow the parent.

The real work item is the 54 modules that declare no Mathlib import at all — invisible to the probe because nothing in their text says what they need. Elaborating all 54 in parallel with `lake env lean` resolves the exposure in minutes where a full build finds one victim per round; exactly 24 need Mathlib and the other 30 were loading 1.79 GB of oleans for nothing.
